DI_cd_pillar_catalogue_init_sgui = {
    scope = character
    effect = {
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable_list = DI_cd_pillars_martial_custom } clear_global_variable_list = DI_cd_pillars_martial_custom }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_martial_custom target = culture_pillar:martial_custom_male_only }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_martial_custom target = culture_pillar:martial_custom_equal }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_martial_custom target = culture_pillar:martial_custom_female_only }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable_list = DI_cd_pillars_ethos } clear_global_variable_list = DI_cd_pillars_ethos }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_ethos target = culture_pillar:ethos_bellicose }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_ethos target = culture_pillar:ethos_stoic }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_ethos target = culture_pillar:ethos_bureaucratic }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_ethos target = culture_pillar:ethos_spiritual }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_ethos target = culture_pillar:ethos_courtly }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_ethos target = culture_pillar:ethos_egalitarian }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_ethos target = culture_pillar:ethos_communal }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable_list = DI_cd_pillars_heritage } clear_global_variable_list = DI_cd_pillars_heritage }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_aldmeri }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_ayleid }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_bosmeri }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_chimeri }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_dunmeri }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_dwemeri }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_falmeri }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_maormeri }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_atmoran_giant }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_atmoran }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_breton }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_cyrodiilic }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_cyrod }

        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_yokudan }

        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_argonian }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_heritage target = culture_pillar:heritage_dremora }

        if = { limit = { has_global_variable_list = DI_cd_pillars_language } clear_global_variable_list = DI_cd_pillars_language }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = DI_cd_pillars_language target = culture_pillar:language_altmeris }
